current: websocket_user accepts connections without JWT verification
target: WebSocket connections MUST verify JWT type claim equals access (Law 41)
delta: Unauthenticated WebSocket endpoint allows any client to connect and broadcast to all users
fix: Add JWT decode with expected_type="access" before websocket.accept()

current: set_rls_context() only sets ContextVars; does not execute SET LOCAL
target: set_rls_context() executes SET LOCAL app.country_code = :cc inside active transaction (Law 5)
delta: Canonical RLS function uses ContextVar injection instead of PostgreSQL SET LOCAL; legacy SET LOCAL path in country_context.py is not wired to canonical function
fix: Wire canonical set_rls_context to execute SET LOCAL via SQLAlchemy event or session-level hook

current: publish_order_created() calls publish() synchronously inside service transaction
target: In-process events must be emitted post-commit to prevent cross-schema transaction locking (Law 3)
delta: Event publishers do not guarantee post-commit emission; failure mid-transaction can leave cross-domain state inconsistent
fix: Emit events from after_commit hook or use event_bus stream with post-commit consumer

current: time.sleep(backoff) blocks event loop in async handler retry
target: Async functions MUST NOT call blocking I/O (Law 60)
delta: Event bus retry loop uses blocking time.sleep() which freezes the event loop during handler failures
fix: Replace time.sleep() with asyncio.sleep() in event_bus retry loop

target: Rate limiting fails closed when unavailable (Law 37)
delta: Rate limiting is off by default in development/test; production toggle required
fix: Enable rate limiting by default; fail closed when Valkey is down

delta: Celery retry backoff cap is 300s (5 min) for most tasks, 1800s (30 min) for periodic tasks; far exceeds 8s target
fix: Reduce retry_backoff_max to 8s for short tasks; document exception for long-running periodic jobs

current: _OBSERVABILITY list labeled "Layer 5" but registered AFTER _SECURITY labeled "Layer 7" in pipeline
target: Middleware layer labels should match registration order
delta: Comment labels on layer variables are misleading; actual registration order in setup_middleware() is correct
fix: Update comment labels on _OBSERVABILITY and _SECURITY to match registration order

current: EventPublisher class marked deprecated but still present in codebase
target: Deprecated code should be removed after migration
delta: EventPublisher is deprecated per WIR-028 but not removed; creates confusion and maintenance burden
fix: Remove EventPublisher class after confirming all callers migrated to event_bus
